name: gh-status
description: Live status of the current branch's GitHub pull request in Claude Code: checks, reviews, threads, mergeability, merge queue, with confirmed merge actions.

command.title: Command name
command.description: Slash command name; if it is taken in a session (for example by a skill), /gh-pr is used instead

accounts.title: Account per owner
accounts.description: Optional owner=login pairs, comma separated, e.g. my-user=my-user,my-org=work-login. Wins over automatic detection.

fastIntervalSeconds.title: Fast interval (s)
fastIntervalSeconds.description: Check interval while checks run or the PR is in the merge queue.

toasts.title: Toasts on state changes
toasts.description: Show a toast when the pipeline, reviews, comments or mergeability change.

colors.title: Color scheme
colors.description: claude follows your Claude Code theme; github uses GitHub's Primer colors

mainStatus.title: Main branch status in the band
mainStatus.description: red shows the failing workflows of the default branch in the band (for example 'main ✗ CI'); off hides it and stops reading them

paneWidthPercent.title: Pane width (%)
paneWidthPercent.description: Share of the terminal width the docked pane opens with (at least 60 columns); 0 leaves it to Claude Code. A width you drag the pane to wins.
